summary:
All six scoped findings are resolved; the 16 prior resolutions remain resolved. No new defects were found in the supplied diff hunks.
Runtime assumptions still require the planned bake-off (docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd-native-design.md:342-345).
Read-only review: no files modified, staged or committed; prohibited scripts were not run; the registry database was not opened.

findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd-native-design.md:72 now requires 'no file under source_paths, test_paths or fixture_paths changed since'. docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd/build-tasks.md:209 requires a retro-only commit to pass and a later source, test or fixture change to fail.

docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd-native-design.md:140 requires the conductor to record calvin_ledger before dispatch and permits 'that exact path and nothing else'; line 865 matches. docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd/build-tasks.md:304-308 tests the assigned path, rejects another pattern-valid ledger, and rejects every write when authorization is absent. The parent-session identifier assumption has an explicit bake-off check at docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd-native-design.md:348.

All seven formerly bare self-test commands now use 'plugins/pd/scripts/': docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd/build-tasks.md:155,178,220,237,253,318,409. The existing pd-html command at line 145 also uses its path. No bare self-test invocation remains.

docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd/build-tasks.md:264 requires instrumentation recording 'every path opened and every connection closed'; lines 265-267 require exactly one read-only source connection, closure 'before step 1', and every later open targeting the copy. This excludes continued migration reads through the original connection.

docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd/build-tasks.md:389 names '~/.claude/pd/gate/<repo key>/<feature id>.json'; line 390 explicitly requires 'two fixture repositories with the same feature id' to retain 'separate totals and budgets', matching docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd-native-design.md:278.

docs/plans/2026-10-14-thin-pd/build-tasks.md:173 moves template compatibility into T3.5's self-test and explicitly adds T3.4 as a dependency. T3.4's proof at lines 155-165 no longer requires T3.5; its prerequisite remains T3.2 at line 153.
